# Optional upstream source dependencies

**Status:** documentation-only placeholder.

The product uses upstream Kaneo directly as its project-management foundation and the official Orchestrator application as an **external** coding-agent tool. No vendor source is needed for the MVP.

The [Orchestrator placeholder](orchestrator/README.md) records the intended optional source pin for reproducible integration testing. A Git submodule points to a specific upstream commit; it does **not** install or automatically update an app on a customer's computer.

Never copy a private cloud submodule or patch original upstream source here. Follow [upstream policy](../docs/upstream-policy.md).
